beats.en_subtitle: Today we mastered the eight foundational rules of interest rates, compounding, and zero curve construction.
beats.en_narration: Today we mastered the eight foundational rules of interest rates, compounding, and zero curve construction.

ui_state.heading: Interest Rates & Zero Curve Master Thread
steps: 1. Benchmark Hierarchy: Treasury yields carry tax conveniences; OIS represents true risk-free funding.
2. Compounding Effect: Higher compounding frequencies yield greater exponential terminal wealth.
3. Equivalence Formula: R_c = m · ln(1 + R_m / m) bridges discrete bank quotes and continuous models.
4. Zero Rate Purity: Zero-coupon spot rates eliminate coupon reinvestment risk across maturities.
5. Bond Pricing Reality: Bonds must be priced as portfolios of zero-coupon cash flows at dedicated rates.
